given_when_then.given: The Store Partner updates the quantity of a perishable SKU in their Real-Time Inventory Snapshot
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to allocate an Order Request for that SKU
given_when_then.then: The system shall reflect the updated quantity immediately and allow allocation only if stock is sufficient

given_when_then.given: An Order Request has successfully locked stock for a perishable item
given_when_then.when: The customer cancels the Order Request before the fulfillment task begins
given_when_then.then: The system shall release the locked stock quantity back to the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot for other orders

given_when_then.given: The data link latency exceeds the defined threshold
given_when_then.when: The system monitors the integrity of the data link between the Store Partner and the platform
given_when_then.then: The system shall flag a synchronization discrepancy

given_when_then.given: A sync failure is detected on the data link
given_when_then.when: The system monitors the integrity of the data link between the Store Partner and the platform
given_when_then.then: The system shall flag a synchronization discrepancy

given_when_then.given: An Order Request is not confirmed within the allocated time window
given_when_then.when: The system monitors locked stock status for the Order Request
given_when_then.then: The system shall automatically release the locked stock

success_criteria: The system flags a synchronization discrepancy when data link latency exceeds the defined threshold.
The system flags a synchronization discrepancy when a sync failure is detected.
The system releases locked stock automatically if the Order Request is not confirmed within the allocated time window.
The system reflects updated quantities in the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot immediately before allowing allocation.
The system prioritizes allocation for perishable items based on expiration date proximity.
